## PR Checklist

Please ensure your Pull Request meets the following requirements:

- [ ] Commit message follows conventional commit guidelines
- [ ] Tests have been added or updated (if applicable)
- [ ] Documentation has been added or updated (if applicable)
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint:all` and `npm run package` locally and verified all checks pass

---

## PR Type

What kind of change does this PR introduce?

<!-- Select ONE or more by marking with an "x". -->

- [ ] Bugfix (`fix`)
- [ ] Feature (`feat`)
- [ ] Performance improvement (`perf`)
- [ ] Refactoring (`refactor`)
- [ ] UI / UX (`ui` / `style`)
- [ ] Tests (`test`)
- [ ] Documentation (`docs`)
- [ ] Build / Packaging (`build`)
- [ ] CI / Workflow (`ci`)
- [ ] Dependency updates (`deps`)
- [ ] Maintenance / Chore (`chore`)
- [ ] Other (please describe below)

---

## Affected Area(s)

<!-- Select all that apply with an "x". -->

- [ ] Electron Backend (Main process, IPC handlers, Dockerode client)
- [ ] Angular Frontend (Browser UI, components, state management)
- [ ] Containers (Lifecycle, restart policy, recreation, mounts & ports)
- [ ] Docker Compose (Group summaries, aggregated metrics, group actions)
- [ ] Real-time Metrics & Charts (CPU, memory, disk/network I/O)
- [ ] Streaming Logs (Log viewer, search, timestamps)
- [ ] Interactive Terminal (xterm.js shell, TTY emulation)
- [ ] Files Browser & Monaco Editor (Container & volume files)
- [ ] Images Management (Pull, tag, inspect, delete)
- [ ] Volumes Management (Inspect, browse files, prune)
- [ ] Networks Management (Inspect, connect/disconnect)
- [ ] Packaging & Installers (electron-builder, NSIS, MSIX, DMG, AppImage, DEB, RPM)
- [ ] Auto-Updater & Update Signatures
- [ ] CI / Workflows / Tooling
- [ ] Documentation (README, assets)
